visual_identity.color_palette: Dusty terracotta skin with teal-blue highlights along the neck spines; pale cream underbelly.
visual_identity.texture: Leathery skin with fine, pebbled scales; the neck spines have a smooth, horn-like keratin texture at the tips.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Two parallel rows of long spines running down the neck; a short, thick tail; large, soulful eyes.

anatomy_constraints.head: Small, boxy sauropod head with a blunt snout; large expressive yellow eyes; positioned low due to the short neck.
anatomy_constraints.neck: Relatively short for a sauropod, featuring two distinct rows of elongated neural spines.
anatomy_constraints.body: Compact, muscular sauropod frame; limbs are stout and pillar-like.

visual_logic.subject: A calm, curious Amargasaurus foraging near a riverbank.
visual_logic.action: Leaning its neck down to reach low ferns, showcasing the unique split-spine profile.
visual_logic.environment: Background features the mottled red clays and green-grey siltstones of the La Amarga formation under a clear, bright sun.

personality: The 'Spiny Wanderer'—gentle, slow-moving, and highly distinctive. He has a peaceful, rhythmic presence.
